node.statement: QRL-T2 (Johnson window; audited SOUND). On dyadic quotient rows, cells with a^2 > (k'-1) n' have list <= n'^2 (Paper D thm:capf-johnson-list, verified in source to hold for arbitrary finite evaluation sets, kappa = k'-1) and the ESP transport carries <= 2 n'^2 at every official field (D >= q(q - 2r - L) > 0 at q >= 4n'^2; inflation factor <= 4n'/(3n'-2) <= 2, worst at the boundary — exact sweep incl. q = 4n'^2). Descent hypotheses (M | gcd(n,k), char not dividing M, M | A) verified at n' >= 64.
